name: io.github.Proofofarchitect/arc-pow-sigils
title: Proof of Architect
description: Read-only MCP tools for Proof of Architect — a proof-of-work NFT collection on Arc: nonce verification, deterministic rarity, live collection stats, and craft-commit verification.

environmentVariables.name: CONTRACT_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: PowMintNFTv3 contract address (defaults to the deployed v3 testnet address).

environmentVariables.name: CRAFT_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: CraftingController v1 address for the craft tools (defaults to the deployed testnet controller).

environmentVariables.name: ARC_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Arc testnet RPC endpoint (defaults to https://rpc.testnet.arc.io).

environmentVariables.name: SITE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base site URL used to build image/metadata links (default https://proofofarchitect.builders).
